messages:
emma_sales: Heads up - FinX (sales POC) wants SG + EU data residency for their POC. They asked for: no-crossover to US if possible, BYOK for keys, explicit subprocessor list for SG edge, and pricing impact for geo-pin + failover policy. Can we confirm options and rough pricing?

jordan_se: Quick clarifying q - when they say "no crossover to US" do they mean network-level never traverses US, or legal/processing location only? Options are: hosted w/ tenant pin + regional failover, Dedicated reserved in SG/EU, or Private (VPC/on-prem). Each has different guarantees.

kevin_ops: Network note: infra regions we run today: asia-southeast1 (SG), asia-northeast1 (TYO), europe-west3 (FRA), europe-west2 (LON), us-west2. For SG edge we use EdgeStream (caching + routing) and TransRoute for global failover. EdgeStream is a subprocessor that may touch request metadata for caching. We can produce subproc attestation.

marta_legal: Flag: we cannot warrant absolute "no-US transit" at IP path level (internet routing can transiently transit), so contract language is usually "data residency: storage and processing within X; network routing best-effort; tenant pinned to region(s)". For strict non-US transit they should consider Private or Dedicated colocated in SG with provider peering. We can provide SOC2/ISO cert copies + redacted subprocess agreements via secure portal.

olivia_eng: Routing behavior details: tenant pinning + sticky routing will prefer SG control plane & SG serving. Failover order defaults SG -> TYO -> FRA, but we can change it. We also support `reject_on_unavailable: true` so if SG capacity is exhausted we return 503 instead of failing over. BYOK: hosted BYOK requires contract amendment; Dedicated & Private fully support external KMS. Example routing policy snippet:
``
{"region_preference": ["asia-southeast1","europe-west3"], "reject_on_unavailable": true, "failover_order": ["asia-southeast1","europe-north1"]}
```

jordan_se: Helpful — can ops confirm if EdgeStream is optional and incremental cost if we disable it? Also need a short summary sentence for pricing delta between: hosted geo-pin, hosted geo-pin + reject_on_unavailable, Dedicated (monthly commit), Private (license + infra).

kevin_ops: EdgeStream is optional; without it SG latency may increase ~15–40ms and cache hit rate drops — but functionally fine. Cost notes (very rough): hosted geo-pin: ~+5% on per-token ops due to routing overlay; `reject_on_unavailable` is configuration only; Dedicated: baseline monthly commit + infra overhead (depends on pool size) — plan for 3–6x hosted baseline on fixed cost but predictable. Private: one-time platform license + infra + support. I'll pull exact numbers into INF ticket.

emma_sales: Great. Can someone assemble a 1-page summary I can send to FinX with: options, risk callouts re: US transit, subprocessor list, BYOK support matrix, and a headline pricing delta? I want it by EOD so I can attach to the security questionnaire.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-4212: "POC FinX SG residency + BYOK pricing" — assignees: @kevin_ops, @olivia_eng, due: 2026-03-23.

marta_legal: I'll attach certs + guidance language to INF-4212 and draft the contract language for the "best-effort" routing clause.

olivia_eng: I'll add routing policy examples and the `reject_on_unavailable` option doc, plus a sample config they can copy.

kevin_ops: I'll add subproc attestation and a 1-page ops runbook (what fails over where) into INF-4212.

emma_sales: Thanks team :heart: — will loop FinX in once INF-4212 has the one-pager and certs.
